apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/__init__..name: Shared resource requests
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/__init__..description: A reusable set of list, add, read, change and remove requests that the simpler per-agent resource screens (goals, boards, tickets and the like) are built on.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/account_a.name: Trading authority
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/account_a.description: Lets the owner grant, confirm with a signed device check, and revoke an agent's authority over a trading account.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_del.name: Agent notification rules
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_del.description: Reads and sets, per agent, how and when it may notify the owner; agents with no rules of their own follow the defaults.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_goa.name: Agent goals
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_goa.description: An agent's goals and knowledge links, offered through the shared resource requests.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_mod.name: Agent's AI model
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_mod.description: Reads and sets which AI model an agent uses, and shows the model card: the choice, the model answering now, the options, and this agent's usage.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_per.name: Agent permissions
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_per.description: Shows an agent's stored permission ladder — what it is allowed to do.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_sec.name: Workspace secrets
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_sec.description: Lists the owner's saved secrets by name, values never leaving the store, and removes one — refusing to delete a secret a connection still uses.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_ski.name: Agent skills
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_ski.description: Lists and inspects the skills an agent can use, keeps every saved version so one can be restored, and lets the owner block specific versions.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_sta.name: Agent live state
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agent_sta.description: Reports what an agent is doing right now, for the live status shown in the apps.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agents.py.name: Agents
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/agents.py.description: Creates, lists, reads, configures and deletes agents and opens an agent's main conversation; one of the busiest parts of the server.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/app_opens.name: App opens
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/app_opens.description: Records the first time the owner opens the app each day, shows that habit, and can forget it.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/artifacts.name: Files & uploads
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/artifacts.description: Stores files the owner or agents upload, lets the owner rewrite a text file, and serves a file back for viewing or download.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/attention.name: Needs your attention
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/attention.description: Gathers what needs the owner across all agents, marks items as seen, and reads or sets the rule for what counts.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/auth.py.name: Sign in
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/auth.py.description: Signs the owner in on web and on the phone, reports the current session, and signs out.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/boards.py.name: Boards
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/boards.py.description: The owner's boards, offered through the shared resource requests.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/cancellat.name: Cancel a run
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/cancellat.description: Stops an agent's run while it is in progress.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/capabilit.name: Capabilities view
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/capabilit.description: Shows everything agents can use right now, each with where it came from, its state, when it was last used, and an undo.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/charts.py.name: Chart data
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/charts.py.description: Returns the data behind a saved chart and refreshes it with the latest market data.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/chat_list.name: Chat lists
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/chat_list.description: Creates, reads, renames, deletes and sets the members of the lists that group chats in the sidebar.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/collabora.name: Collaboration view
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/collabora.description: Shows who is working together on a conversation, and the details of one collaboration session.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/connectio.name: Test a connection
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/connectio.description: Checks that a model provider accepts a key, or that an outside AI connection or a broker works, before the owner saves it, without storing anything.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/device_au.name: Trusted devices
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/device_au.description: Lists the owner's trusted devices and lets them add one with a verification step or remove one, so sensitive actions can be approved from a known device.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/events.py.name: Live updates
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/events.py.description: Keeps an open connection that streams live updates to the web app, resuming from where it left off after a reconnect.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/incoming_.name: Incoming calls
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/incoming_.description: Reads and sets who may call the owner by voice, shows a current incoming call, and lets the owner answer or decline it.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/integrati.name: Save a secret value
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/integrati.description: Saves the secret values an integration needs, for the owner's own session only.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/knowledge.name: Agent knowledge
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/knowledge.description: Reads an agent's knowledge notes and links and adds, edits or removes a note; editing replaces the old note with the new text.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/market.py.name: Market data
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/market.py.description: Serves the tradable instruments and symbols, one instrument's details, live quotes, price candles, and the economic calendar.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/mcp.py.name: AI-assistant connections store
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/mcp.py.description: The shared store for connections that let outside AI assistants look things up in the app; other requests use it rather than calling it directly.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/memory.py.name: Memory & owner profile
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/memory.py.description: Reads and updates each agent's memory and the owner's own profile, preferences and the lines of what Lonora knows about them, keeping a history any change can be undone from.

GET /.name: List items
GET /.description: Lists the owner's items for one of the simple resources (such as goals or boards), optionally filtered to one agent or chat.

POST /.name: Add an item
POST /.description: Adds one item to a simple resource for the owner.

GET /{resource_id}.name: Read an item
GET /{resource_id}.description: Reads one item of a simple resource by its id.

PUT /{resource_id}.name: Change an item
PUT /{resource_id}.description: Replaces one item's contents, refusing the change if someone else edited it first.

DELETE /{resource_id}.name: Remove an item
DELETE /{resource_id}.description: Deletes one item of a simple resource.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/account-authoriti.name: List trading authorities
GET /agents/{agent_id}/account-authoriti.description: Lists the trading-account authorities granted to one agent, newest first.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/account-authorit.name: Propose trading authority
POST /agents/{agent_id}/account-authorit.description: Proposes giving an agent authority over a trading account, for all symbols or a chosen set; it only takes effect once confirmed.

POST /account-authorities/{identifier}/c.name: Start device confirmation
POST /account-authorities/{identifier}/c.description: Begins confirming a trading-authority grant by asking the owner's trusted device to sign it.

POST /account-authorities/verify.name: Confirm trading authority
POST /account-authorities/verify.description: Finishes the grant once the owner's device has signed, activating the authority and noting it in the conversation.

POST /account-authorities/{identifier}/r.name: Revoke trading authority
POST /account-authorities/{identifier}/r.description: Takes back an agent's authority over a trading account.

GET /agents/notifications.name: Agents with their own rules
GET /agents/notifications.description: Lists the agents that have their own notification rules; any other agent follows the defaults.

PUT /agents/{agent_id}/notifications.name: Set an agent's rules
PUT /agents/{agent_id}/notifications.description: Saves how and when one agent may notify the owner.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/model.name: Read model choice
GET /agents/{agent_id}/model.description: Shows which AI model an agent is set to use.

PUT /agents/{agent_id}/model.name: Set model choice
PUT /agents/{agent_id}/model.description: Changes which AI model an agent uses, from any model of a connected provider.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/model/summary.name: Model card
GET /agents/{agent_id}/model/summary.description: Returns everything the model card shows: the choice, the model answering now, the models the owner can pick, and this agent's usage.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/permissions.name: Read agent permissions
GET /agents/{agent_id}/permissions.description: Shows an agent's stored permission ladder.

GET /secrets.name: List saved secrets
GET /secrets.description: Lists the owner's saved secrets by name; the values themselves never leave the store.

DELETE /secrets/{secret_id}.name: Delete a secret
DELETE /secrets/{secret_id}.description: Removes one saved secret, unless a connection still uses it.

GET /skills/{skill_id}/versions.name: Skill version history
GET /skills/{skill_id}/versions.description: Lists every saved version of a skill, newest first.

POST /skills/{skill_id}/restore.name: Restore a skill version
POST /skills/{skill_id}/restore.description: Brings an older skill version back by saving it as the skill's next version.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/catalog.name: Agent's skills
GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/catalog.description: Lists the skills one agent can use.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/catalog/{s.name: Skill details
GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/catalog/{s.description: Shows the details of one skill an agent can use.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/revocation.name: Blocked skill versions
GET /agents/{agent_id}/skills/revocation.description: Lists the skill versions the owner has blocked for one agent.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/skills/revocatio.name: Block a skill version
POST /agents/{agent_id}/skills/revocatio.description: Blocks a specific skill version for one agent.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/state.name: Agent live state
GET /agents/{agent_id}/state.description: Reports what one agent is doing right now.

POST /agents.name: Create an agent
POST /agents.description: Creates a new agent from a name, picture and colour.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/conversation.name: Open agent conversation
POST /agents/{agent_id}/conversation.description: Opens or returns the agent's main ongoing conversation.

POST /app-opens.name: Record app open
POST /app-opens.description: Notes that the owner opened the app, keeping the first open of each day.

GET /app-opens.name: Read opening habit
GET /app-opens.description: Returns how regularly the owner opens the app.

DELETE /app-opens.name: Forget app opens
DELETE /app-opens.description: Clears the record of when the owner opened the app.

POST /upload.name: Upload a file
POST /upload.description: Stores a file the owner or an agent uploads, keeping a PDF's text and page images beside it for agents to read.

PUT /{artifact_id}/text.name: Edit a text file
PUT /{artifact_id}/text.description: Lets the owner rewrite a stored text file; other kinds of file cannot be edited.

GET /{artifact_id}/file.name: Download a file
GET /{artifact_id}/file.description: Serves a stored file back for viewing or download.

GET /attention/view.name: Attention summary
GET /attention/view.description: Gathers what needs the owner across all agents.

GET /attention.name: Attention inbox
GET /attention.description: Lists the items waiting for the owner's attention.

GET /attention/policy.name: Read attention rule
GET /attention/policy.description: Shows the rule for what counts as needing the owner's attention.

PUT /attention/policy.name: Set attention rule
PUT /attention/policy.description: Changes the rule for what counts as needing the owner's attention.

POST /auth/login.name: Sign in (web)
POST /auth/login.description: Signs the owner in from the browser.

POST /auth/mobile/login.name: Sign in (phone)
POST /auth/mobile/login.description: Signs the owner in from the phone app.

GET /auth/session.name: Current session
GET /auth/session.description: Reports whether the owner is signed in and who they are.

POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel.name: Cancel a run
POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel.description: Stops one agent run that is in progress.

GET /capabilities.name: Capabilities view
GET /capabilities.description: Returns everything agents can use now, with source, state, last use and an undo.

GET /{chart_id}/scene.name: Chart contents
GET /{chart_id}/scene.description: Returns the data that makes up one saved chart.

POST /{chart_id}/refresh.name: Refresh a chart
POST /{chart_id}/refresh.description: Updates one chart with the latest market data.

GET /chat-lists.name: List chat lists
GET /chat-lists.description: Returns the lists that group chats in the sidebar.

POST /chat-lists.name: Create a chat list
POST /chat-lists.description: Makes a new list for grouping chats.

PUT /chat-lists/{list_id}/members.name: Set chat list members
PUT /chat-lists/{list_id}/members.description: Changes which chats belong to a list.

GET /threads/{thread_id}/collaboration.name: Conversation collaboration
GET /threads/{thread_id}/collaboration.description: Shows who is working together on one conversation.

GET /collaboration/{session_id}.name: Collaboration details
GET /collaboration/{session_id}.description: Shows the details of one collaboration session.

POST /providers/{provider}/test.name: Test a model provider
POST /providers/{provider}/test.description: Checks a model provider's key and settings work, without saving them.

POST /mcp/test.name: Test an AI connection
POST /mcp/test.description: Checks a connection that lets outside AI assistants look things up works, without saving it; remote ones only.

POST /trading/connections/test.name: Test a broker connection
POST /trading/connections/test.description: Checks a broker connection works before it is saved.

GET /auth/devices/config.name: Device setup info
GET /auth/devices/config.description: Returns what a device needs to enrol as a trusted device.

POST /auth/devices/enrollment.name: Start adding a device
POST /auth/devices/enrollment.description: Begins adding a device as a trusted one.

POST /auth/devices/enrollment/verify.name: Confirm a new device
POST /auth/devices/enrollment/verify.description: Finishes adding a trusted device once it has proven itself.

DELETE /auth/devices/{device_id}.name: Remove a device
DELETE /auth/devices/{device_id}.description: Takes a device off the trusted list.

GET /events.name: Catch up on updates
GET /events.description: Returns recent updates so a reconnecting app can catch up.

GET /events/stream.name: Live update stream
GET /events/stream.description: Keeps an open connection streaming live updates to the web app.

GET /voice/incoming/policy.name: Read call rule
GET /voice/incoming/policy.description: Shows who may call the owner by voice.

PUT /voice/incoming/policy.name: Set call rule
PUT /voice/incoming/policy.description: Changes who may call the owner by voice.

GET /voice/incoming.name: Current incoming call
GET /voice/incoming.description: Shows a voice call coming in to the owner.

POST /voice/incoming/{identifier}/respon.name: Answer or decline a call
POST /voice/incoming/{identifier}/respon.description: Records the owner's answer to an incoming voice call.

POST /secrets.name: Save a secret value
POST /secrets.description: Saves the secret values an integration needs, for the owner's session only.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge.name: Read agent knowledge
GET /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge.description: Returns one agent's knowledge notes and links as a single list.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/notes.name: Add a knowledge note
POST /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/notes.description: Adds a note to an agent's knowledge.

PUT /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/notes/{.name: Edit a knowledge note
PUT /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/notes/{.description: Replaces a knowledge note with new text, which is kept as a new note.

DELETE /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/note.name: Delete a knowledge note
DELETE /agents/{agent_id}/knowledge/note.description: Removes a note from an agent's knowledge.

GET /market/instruments.name: Tradable instruments
GET /market/instruments.description: Lists the instruments that can be traded or watched.

GET /market/instrument.name: Instrument details
GET /market/instrument.description: Returns the details of one instrument.

GET /market/quote.name: Live quote
GET /market/quote.description: Returns the latest price for one instrument.

GET /market/candles.name: Price candles
GET /market/candles.description: Returns price candles over time for a chart.

GET /market/calendar.name: Economic calendar
GET /market/calendar.description: Returns upcoming economic events that can move the market.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/memory/revisions.name: Memory history
GET /agents/{agent_id}/memory/revisions.description: Lists past changes to one agent's memory.

GET /owner/profile/lines.name: What Lonora knows about you
GET /owner/profile/lines.description: Lists every line of the owner's profile with where it came from: what the owner said, or what Lonora observed.

POST /owner/profile/lines.name: Correct a profile line
POST /owner/profile/lines.description: Records the owner's correction or deletion of one profile line, as the owner's own words.

PUT /owner/preferences.name: Update owner preferences
PUT /owner/preferences.description: Saves the owner's preferences — how to reach them, reply language, name and form of address — as one change.

GET /owner/profile/revisions.name: Profile history
GET /owner/profile/revisions.description: Lists past changes to the owner's profile.

POST /memory/revisions/{revision_id}/rev.name: Undo a memory change
POST /memory/revisions/{revision_id}/rev.description: Undoes one change as a new change attributed to the owner, leaving later changes in place.

GET /memory/semantic/config.name: Read memory search setting
GET /memory/semantic/config.description: Shows the setting for how memory is searched by meaning.

PUT /memory/semantic/config.name: Set memory search setting
PUT /memory/semantic/config.description: Changes the setting for how memory is searched by meaning.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/memory/semantic.name: Add a memory note
POST /agents/{agent_id}/memory/semantic.description: Adds a note to an agent's searchable memory.
